review.headline: Easy 9 km completed on target: 9.00 km at a steady 5:48/km, inside the 5:11-6:13 easy band.
observations: Distance 9.004 km against 9.0 planned; moving time 3130 s with every km split at 348 s, so pacing was very even.
Average HR 137 (range 135-139) and max 140 indicate genuinely easy effort, consistent with recent easy runs (4-week average 139).
Cadence 174 spm and efficiency 1.26 are in line with the last easy runs, so no sign of fatigue or form breakdown.
The session fits the easy purpose; the run followed the Nov 10 tempo stop and the athlete logged no note or RPE.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so subjective effort is unknown.
Week 2 completed only 25 of 45 planned km, and the Nov 10 tempo was cut short at 6 km, so the week has run below plan.
